core.title: Passage Function Exit Device Sierra Lever Trim, Dorma QRT330E

text.description_html:
Dorma QRT330E, Passage Function Exit Device Lever Trim

Passage function exit device trim with Sierra lever and round rose. Works with Dorma standard duty series QRD300, QRM300, QET300, and QRT300 exit devices.

Features and Specifications:

  • Finish: Aluminum
  • Lever Length: 4.98"
  • Lever Projection: 3.15"
  • Rose Diameter: 3.12"
  • Rose Projection: .52"
  • Handing: Reversible, non-handed
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4"
  • Grade 1
  • Warranty: Lifetime mechanical, 3 Year Finish

Special Ordered Item. NO RETURNS
